relations.reading: An integrity function can coordinate common decision conditions while retaining the distinct authority and expertise of its constituent disciplines.

relations.title: Frontera de integridad operacional
relations.reading: A shared integrity label becomes useful only when the mission states which cross-domain conditions affect trustworthy operation and who owns them.

relations.title: Activación de misión
relations.reading: A mission team and a federated integrity function can share explicit decision interfaces without requiring the same organizational structure.

relations.title: Frontera de integridad operacional
relations.reading: Mission-level operational integrity and an enterprise integrity function operate at different scopes and should connect through explicit responsibilities rather than be collapsed into one role.

relations.title: Continuidad distribuida
relations.reading: Participant-local positioning offers a later architectural comparison for distributed operational intelligence without presuming one global controller or shared objective.

relations.title: Fallo de composición
relations.reading: An AI integrity function could own the review of composed evidence sufficiency while preserving the specialist ownership of identity, authority and model evaluation.

relations.title: Estado de una afirmación
relations.reading: A Tiger Team can contribute field evidence and implementation discipline without its delivery result becoming proof of the mathematical or architectural layers above it.
